title: VAL threshold sweep + Needs Review policy + threshold metadata
description: New src/sweep_threshold.py: runs eval + prob collection on VAL manifest ONLY (guard: refuse test.csv path), sweeps thresholds 0.50-0.95 step 0.01, computes acc/balanced-acc/damaged-recall/FN per threshold, selects best by balanced accuracy then damaged recall (never plain accuracy; reject candidates with damaged recall < 0.9158 baseline). Needs Review policy: sample with p_damaged < selected threshold and predicted Not Damaged flagged Needs Review (mirrors backend review band). Writes reports/threshold_sweep.csv + reports/damage_threshold.json {selected_threshold, val_metrics, selection_rule, sweep_range, class_names, generated_at} + backend_config_hint.DAMAGE_REVIEW_THRESHOLD. Test set NOT read anywhere.
acceptance_criteria: Selection rule = max balanced accuracy, tie-break damaged recall; never plain accuracy
Selected threshold written to reports/damage_threshold.json with val_metrics
label 0 = Damaged preserved in p_damaged column
validation: ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_sweep_threshold.py -q && ./.venv/bin/python src/sweep_threshold.py --labels data/damage/manifests/val.csv --image-root . --checkpoint models/egg_grader.pth --output-csv reports/threshold_sweep.csv --output-json reports/damage_threshold.json && ./.venv/bin/python -c "import json; t=json.load(open('reports/damage_threshold.json')); assert 0.50 <= t['selected_threshold'] <= 0.95, t; import pandas as pd; df=pd.read_csv('reports/threshold_sweep.csv'); assert len(df)==96, len(df)"
